section.32: The Book of Jihad and Expeditions

32.name_native: The Book of Jihad and Expeditions

hadiths.text: It has been narrated on the authority of Hisham (who learnt it from his father) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said (to Sa'd):You have adjudged their case with the judgment of God. the Exalted and Glorified
